assets/vo/s01-a5d425d8.mp3: Here's how Anthropic's sales team rebuilt inbound with an agent, in under sixty seconds.
assets/vo/s01-bfa0eb4b.mp3: Inbound means the people who contact sales first.
assets/vo/s02-38e248df.mp3: Say you fill in the Contact Sales form. A rep qualifies you, then passes you on, and you could wait days.
assets/vo/s03-688639ac.mp3: With tens of thousands of requests a month, the team couldn't keep up, yet most questions were simple, like what a plan costs.
assets/vo/s04-fa587bf3.mp3: So one engineer built a buying agent. It asks what you're trying to solve, then answers from the docs. It recommends a plan, sometimes the Team plan instead of Enterprise.
assets/vo/s05-09a1bb95.mp3: Every conversation ends one of three ways. You can buy at checkout, get a quick answer, or be handed to a person, with the full conversation and the reason it escalated.
assets/vo/s06-35de5505.mp3: Those hand-offs become real sales opportunities more than twice as often as the old form's leads, and they close about five days faster.
